initial-dialogue.npc: You don't know me? I am Bosun Zarah!
I won twelfth place in the Etceteria Boatswain Championships!
I mopped the deck on the fastest ship to complete the Kourend Circuit!
I was one of only three survivors on the first ship to almost damage the Sharhai!

steps.player: Well, at some point I hope to be hiring a crew of my own. When that happens, you seem like you have all the... qualifications... needed to join.

steps.npc: Great! Don't take too long though, as I'm sure plenty of others will be wanting to try and recruit me first!

steps.text: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.

options.text: Given your... skills... would you like to join my crew?

steps.player: Given your... skills... would you like to join my crew?

steps.text: If the player's Sailing level is under 80 or the player has not completed the easy, medium, and hard Fremennik diary:

steps.npc: Ha! You can't command the legendary Bosun Zarah!

steps.text: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 80 Sailing. Completion of Royal Trouble. Completion of the Easy, Medium and Hard Fremennik Achievement Diaries.
If the player's Sailing level is at least 80:

steps.npc: Anything for another shot at the Sharhai!

steps.text: You recruit Bosun Zarah as a crew member. She heads off in search of your boat.

options.text: Well, good luck with it all.

steps.player: Well, good luck with it all.

subsequent-dialogue.npc: Ah, one of my fans is back! Hello!
Bosun Zarah of course! Boatswain Championships... Kourend Circuit... The list is endless!

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: Hello there. How are you enjoying being part of the crew?

when-at-the-pandemonium.npc: I suppose the real question is how are you enjoying having me as part of your crew?

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: It's fine I suppose, thanks for asking.

while-at-sea-while-idle.npc: Let me know when we reach the Sharhai.
You don't want me doing anything so I don't show up the rest of the crew, right?
